parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC). You must specify `NetworkInterfaceId` or `NetworkInterfacePermissionId.N` to determine the query scope.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfacePermissionId
parameters.description: The list of network interface controller (NIC) permission IDs. Number of elements in the list: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the network interface controller (NIC) permission list.

Minimum value: 1

Default value: 1

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for the paged query.

Maximum value: 100

Default value: 10

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the network interface controller (NIC) permissions. You can invoke [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
